title: OVMS Metric Weekly Sample Age Trend
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ovms:metric sample_age_sec=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(sample_age_sec) as avg_duration, max(sample_age_sec) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst sample age for Open Vehicles metric events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture sample_age_sec on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average sample age with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly whether Open Vehicles metric tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
